exclusions.reason: Global numeric caches, sequence and report side crossing devices are unsafe for per-bed state and commands. Retain values per address/profile and correlate report side within one owned exchange.
Original P3 packets exceed native ATT admission and truncate one-byte lengths. Preserve the envelope within negotiated MTU-minus3 and representable body length.

Unawaited fragment futures can continue after rejected earlier writes and have no complete result. Await/fail-fast batches, retain locks and15s write deadline, and never publish a suppressed write as success.
Reusing the first map value across L/R misattributes sensor data. Consume each explicitly named side independently.
Three-value split fails a five-field consumer. Preserve raw bytes and parser error without fabricating fields or publishing an incomplete coherent sample.

exclusions.source: ANALYSIS.md alarm row49; DateTime weekday proof; alarm64f35c
exclusions.reason: One-shot Sunday computation can wrap to0 or collide with repeat flag. Use the proven Sunday-first bit layout and next occurrence, retain valid weekday/repeat behavior.
Unbounded gzip/buffer allocation and exceptions escaping Bluetooth callbacks are unsafe in HA. Bound4MiB, preserve accepted mutations/timer order, report malformed input without success.

Late uncorrelated responses and old-client callbacks must not reach a new physical/side exchange. Serialize requests, bound silence rather than total progressing-transfer duration, and close a cancelled/failed report session.
Do not recreate a phone-global motion timer that can outlive its owner or fail to release on task cancellation. Bound HA holds and send fresh STOP in finally.

The source can deduplicate two physical devices by the same original name when no hyphen exists. Preserve the claimed identity for diagnostics, but keep HA physical-address ownership and never merge/suppress beds by a potentially colliding app name.
Out-of-range calendar years wrap to a different binary year. Reject binary report years outside2000..2255; retain the full supported calendar for P3 JSON and all legacy records.

exclusions.source: HISTORY-DISPATCH.json; observer Map.forEach; MFP local catch3bc6b0
exclusions.reason: Do not propagate a diagnostic/UI observer exception into HA Bluetooth or let one independent raw observer suppress another complete observation. Preserve parser mutation/timer order and current physical ownership; guarded HA callbacks isolate observer failures.

Mobile route-selected report refresh, account/SQL fallback, dialogs, global device maps and OS scan/permission policies are companion infrastructure. Exact bed commands are exposed explicitly; HA adapter/proxy/reconnect support remains.

exclusions.source: candidate OTA; P2 commands74/75/76; P3 q_ota; FirmwareManager598c98/5b0ff4/5b57d8
exclusions.reason: Firmware acquisition/update and related transport lifecycle are outside direct BLE bed controls. Version display is retained.
Account/cloud/captcha/WebView/music infrastructure has no normal direct bed-write feature.
Bed Wi-Fi/network/provisioning is outside product scope; no app-owned reachable provisioning command was found.
Local SQL, month/day chart grouping and derived health/stress/recovery scores are companion analytics. All incoming BLE records, fields and direct derived sensor state are retained.
Random debug observer injection emits no physical BLE write.
